title: Model the Annotation, Not the Noise: Semantic Annotation-Channel Prompt Learning against Noisy Labels
abstract: arXiv:2611.26702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parameter-efficient prompt learning has become a cornerstone for adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), yet it remains highly vulnerable to label noise in few-shot Web and retrieval scenarios. Existing noise robust methods typically rely on hard sample selection or deterministic label correction, which discard valuable semantic ambiguity and overlook how observed annotations are actually generated. To bridge this gap, we reformulate noisy prompt learning through the perspective of data generation, proposing SACP, a Semantic-aware Annotation Channel-based Prompt learning framework. Instead of suppressing noise heuristically, SACP decouples latent clean-label prediction from instance-dependent annotation generation. By integrating frozen VLM semantic priors with lightweight visual residuals, SACP constructs a structured annotation channel optimized via generalized expectation-maximization with soft posteriors. translated_title: 建模标注而非噪声：面向噪声标签的语义标注通道提示学习
translated_abstract: 参数高效的提示学习已成为适配预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）的基石，但在少样本网络与检索场景中，它对标签噪声仍然高度脆弱。现有的噪声鲁棒方法通常依赖于硬样本选择或确定性的标签纠正，这些做法丢弃了宝贵的语义歧义信息，并忽视了观测到的标注实际上是如何生成的。为弥合这一差距，我们从数据生成的视角重新表述噪声提示学习，提出了SACP——一种基于语义感知标注通道的提示学习框架。SACP并不启发式地抑制噪声，而是将潜在干净标签预测与依赖实例的标注生成过程解耦。通过将冻结的VLM语义先验与轻量级视觉残差相结合，SACP构建了一个结构化的标注通道，并通过带有软后验的广义期望最大化算法进行优化。此外……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SACP框架，从数据生成视角将潜在干净标签预测与实例相关的标注生成过程解耦，通过融合冻结VLM语义先验与轻量级视觉残差构建语义感知标注通道，并利用广义期望最大化与软后验进行优化，从而有效应对噪声标签问题。
en_tdlr: SACP reformulates noisy-label prompt learning from a data-generation perspective by decoupling latent clean-label prediction from instance-dependent annotation generation, and constructs a semantic-aware annotation channel optimized via generalized expectation-maximization with soft posteriors to robustly handle label noise.
